function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**Next major festival in the United States (after Oct 19 2026)**  
> **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival**  
> *Dates:* **October 27 – November 6, 2026**  
> *Location:* New Orleans, Louisiana (Convention Center, French Quarter, and surrounding venues)  
> *What to expect:*  
> * 10‑day celebration of jazz, blues, gospel, world‑music, and Cajun/Creole traditions.  
> * Main stages (Jazz Fest, Blues Fest, Gospel Fest, World Fest) with headline acts and local talent.  
> * Street festivals, parades, food vendors, craft markets, and cultural workshops.  
> * Free‑to‑enter “Jazz Fest” stage for most days; ticketed passes for the main stages and special events.  
> * Ticket options (2026 pricing is projected based on past years):  
>   * Day Pass – ~$25 (valid for one day on the main stage).  
>   * 3‑Day Pass – ~$75 (covers three consecutive days).  
>   * 5‑Day Pass – ~$120 (covers five consecutive days).  
>   * Full‑Festival Pass – ~$200 (covers all 10 days).  
> * Official website: [nojazzfest.com](https://www.nojazzfest.com) – check for updated dates, lineup, and ticket sales.  

---

### Why this is the “next” festival

- **Timing:** The festival starts just 8 days after today’s date (Oct 19 2026).  
- **Scale:** It’s one of the largest and most iconic music festivals in the U.S., drawing over 300,000 visitors each year.  
- **Accessibility:** New Orleans is a major travel hub with multiple airports and a well‑established tourism infrastructure.  

---

### Quick planning checklist

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Travel** | Fly into Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport (MSY). Consider staying in the French Quarter or nearby hotel districts. |
| **Accommodation** | Book early—hotel rates rise as the festival approaches. Look for package deals that include festival passes. |
| **Tickets** | Purchase online via the official site or authorized resellers. Keep an eye out for early‑bird discounts. |
| **Transportation** | Public transit (Streetcars, buses) is reliable. Ride‑share services are plentiful. |
| **Weather** | Late October in New Orleans is mild (70–80 °F during the day, 55–65 °F at night). Pack layers and a light rain jacket. |
| **Health & Safety** | Bring a mask if you’re concerned about COVID‑19; check local guidelines. Have travel insurance that covers event cancellations. |

---

### Other notable festivals happening soon (for future reference)

| Festival | Dates | Location | Highlights |
|----------|-------|----------|------------|
| **Oktoberfest NYC** | Oct 28 – Nov 6, 2026 | New York City | German beer, bratwurst, live music. |
| **Sundance Film Festival** | Jan 10 – 20, 2027 | Park City, Utah | Premier indie films, industry panels. |
| **Burning Man** | Aug 27 – Sep 4, 2027 | Black Rock Desert, Nevada | Art installations, community art, music. |
| **Comic‑Con International** | Jul 21 – 24, 2027 | San Diego, CA | Comic books, sci‑fi, cosplay. |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more details on any of these events, or if you’re interested in a different type of festival (e.g., food, film, tech).
